original.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 adds a refreshPolicy field (CreatedOnce, Periodic or OnChange) to the ExternalSecret spec, and to ClusterExternalSecret's spec.externalSecretSpec, to control how the Secret is synchronized.

decision.reason: The release note [ev-585616b932d5] says a refreshPolicy field was added to ExternalSecret. The rendered CRD diff [ev-efc5158ff817] shows spec.refreshPolicy as a new field (∅ → schema) in externalsecrets.external-secrets.io. The CRD schema validator confirms the field exists only in the target release's bundle [ev-9889c9b8706d] [ev-e08924afdc47]. Neither the note nor the diff says the change is tied to one API version, so leaving version out of the subject is correct, and the change type "added" is directly supported.
